_national.labelling: UK GI scheme (retained EU law since 2021): PDOs English Wine and Welsh Wine (still and quality sparkling), plus Sussex and Darnibole; PGIs English Regional and Welsh Regional. Wine made in the UK from imported grapes or must ("British wine") is not wine under these schemes. Vintage and single-variety claims follow the 85% rule.

gb-darnibole.min_alcohol: Total alcohol 10 to 13% (up to 15%); residual sugar under 7 g/l; acidity 6 to 8.5 g/l.
gb-darnibole.styles: Dry still white from a single delimited area at Camel Valley, Cornwall; hand-picked, crushed within 2 hours, cool fermented, no animal products, screwcap, made at the adjoining Camel Valley winery.

gb-english-wine.varieties: Still: a long list incl. Bacchus, Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Seyval Blanc, Ortega, Reichensteiner, Solaris and hybrids. Quality Sparkling: Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Pinot Noir Précoce, Pinot Meunier, Pinot Blanc, Pinot Gris only.
gb-english-wine.min_alcohol: Still: natural at least 6.0%; enrichment up to 3% (3.5% in exceptional years); actual at least 9% if enriched, 8.5% for unenriched white; max 15% total. Sparkling: cuvée natural at least 6%, total at least 9%, finished at least 10% actual.
gb-english-wine.ageing: Quality Sparkling: traditional method only (second fermentation in bottle), at least 9 months on lees, disgorged. No sweetening of the cuvée; acidification max 1.5 g/l.
gb-english-wine.labelling: "English Sparkling Wine" is the common term for the PDO Quality Sparkling category; each wine must pass an independent analysis and tasting.

gb-sussex.varieties: Sparkling: Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier, Arbanne, Pinot Gris, Pinot Blanc, Petit Meslier, Pinot Noir Précoce. Still: 27 varieties incl. Bacchus, Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Pinot Gris, Ortega, Solaris, Dornfelder, Rondo.
gb-sussex.min_alcohol: Sparkling: vineyard average natural alcohol at least 8% (62 Oe, 15 Brix), no parcel below 7.5%; finished at least 11%; cuvée at least 10%. Still: natural at least 8%, finished at least 10%. Enrichment max 3% (3.5% exceptionally).
gb-sussex.max_yield: 12 t/ha (14 t/ha in exceptional years); sparkling must max 80 hl/ha.
gb-sussex.ageing: Sparkling: traditional method, at least 15 months in bottle before release, of which at least 12 months on lees plus 3 months after disgorgement; whole-bunch pressing (except rosé and red); hand harvest (machine only by dispensation).
gb-sussex.labelling: Single-variety sparkling at least 90% (Blanc de Blancs 90% Chardonnay; Blanc de Noirs 90% Pinot Noir and/or Meunier); vintage 85%. Optional terms "Sparkling", "Classic", "Origin". "Product of England" and "protected designation of origin" mandatory. Grown and made in East and West Sussex. Every wine passes a lab and panel test (Campden BRI).
gb-sussex.other: Registered 2022 as the UK's first regional sparkling PDO.

gb-welsh-wine.labelling: Welsh Wine PDO mirrors the English Wine PDO structure (still and quality sparkling; analysis and tasting).
